Interaction Handler

Handles entity interactions with other entities.

Component Mob

Schema

JSON
{
  "interactionHandler": {}
}

Description

The Interaction Handler component handles entity interactions with other entities. It provides the framework for detecting and responding to interactions between entities in the game world.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
No configurable fields. The component operates with default interaction behavior.

Example

JSON
{
  "interactionHandler": {}
}
